Name: Administrative Sector
description: The main task of the Administrative Sector is the organizational and methodological support for the effective operation of the State Agency for Tourism Development of Ukraine.

Name: Finance and Budget Sector
description: The main task of the Finance and Budget Sector is the organization of accounting and reporting in the system of the State Agency for Tourism Development of Ukraine.

Name: Chief Specialist for Corruption Prevention and Detection
description: The main task is the implementation and execution of measures to prevent and detect corruption-related offenses.

Name: Chief Specialist for Internal Control Coordination
description: Organization and implementation of internal control in the State Agency for Tourism Development of Ukraine and enterprises under its management.
